name: Center-Pier Highway Swing Swing Bridge
title: Center-Pier Highway Swing Swing Bridge
description: Center-Pier Highway Swing Swing Bridge is a complete swing bridge blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. The design calls for 140 ft pivot span with 28 ft roadway and full 180-degree rotation, built from Steel through-truss pivot span on concrete center pier. Pivot pier carries full span dead load on center bearing. Fenders guide vessels clear of the pivot pier. The plan sheets include center pier and foundation sheets, pivot span framing plans, and drive and locking mechanism details. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices. Signature-line original design by the JAH system; verify against local codes before building.
